Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema

Class IndexDefinition

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.IndexDefinition
public final class IndexDefinition extends Object
An index or unique index of a Blueprint, with chained calls for a partial index, column order and collation: table.unique("email").where("deleted", false).desc("email").

Like a column, a definition changes only inside the schema callback and is frozen once the schema builder has checked the blueprint. Conditions are joined by and.

  • Method Details

    • where

      public IndexDefinition where(String column, Object value)
      Limits the index to rows where a column equals a value; null means whereNull(String).
      Parameters:
      column - the column name, never null; it need not be an indexed column
      value - a String, Boolean, integer type, BigDecimal, finite Double or Float, or null
      Returns:
      this definition
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if column is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is empty or has a control character, or the value has another type or is not finite
      IllegalStateException - if the definition is frozen

    • asc

      public IndexDefinition asc(String column)
      Sorts an indexed column ascending, which is the database's default.

      Throws:

      public IndexDefinition collate(String column, String collation)
      Sets the collation of an indexed column, by its database name such as NOCASE.
      Parameters:
      column - one of the index's columns, never null
      collation - the collation name, never null
      Returns:
      this definition
      Throws:

      IllegalArgumentException - if the column is not in the index, or the collation name is empty or has a quote or control character
